findings.statement: D4 is a case report titled "Difficult diagnosis and genetic analysis of fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva: a case report" and reports a sixteen-year-old male patient with the classic features of FOP who was managed by making a genetic analysis.

In D4, the patient developed tender stiffness of his shoulders and neck at age 9, and over the next 4 years he experienced multiple similar swellings on the upper back; subsequently, movement of the shoulders and neck was limited, and masses grew progressively.

In D4, the patient was brought to the emergency room with pain and swelling in his upper back, where a biopsy had been performed two months before, and the pathological examination showed heterotopic ossification of unclear cause.
